title: Coding workers slice 3: complete the Worker reporting and lifecycle contract (follow-up guidance, Failed notes, attribution regressions, docs)
outcome: Worker follow-ups and failures report truthfully and consistently through the production paths, with attribution regressions and documentation matching the implementation. No new route, field, UI or tool, and no authority expansion.
acceptance: Every accepted Worker follow-up receives the bounded Git-handoff and child-reported native-test reporting guidance without granting staging, commit, push or integration authority. Worker failure results retain Notes from the same current-attempt packet that selected the ordinary failure outcome, including an Idle completion with a trailing assistant chunk; Error-state strict-latest selection, rejected-follow-up behavior, and non-Worker result contracts remain unchanged.

Production-path regressions demonstrate owning-parent result/output attribution for promoted queued follow-ups, queued follow-ups that never start, started follow-up failure/cancellation, a missing resident prompt boundary, and legacy results without workerOutputUnavailable. Assertions distinguish each explicit unavailable note from transcript command status, child claims and watcher observations; verify true/false/absent output-flag behavior, wrong-parent rejection on both result routes, and persistence without inheriting earlier-attempt evidence. Result retrieval and settlement add no Git mutation, integration action or host-verification creation.

The documented Worker contract matches the implementation: optional baseRevision/worktreePath, mutable workspace locators, workerOutputUnavailable true/false/absent and summaryFallback, changedFiles/commandsRun and observation semantics, current adapter profiles, advisory ownedPaths, workspace separation rather than containment, and the still-refused trusted frontmatter ingress. Existing read-only reviewer/evaluator and non-Worker behavior remains covered. The exact final input passes the maintained five-stage gate and an independent different-vendor review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding; independent acceptance is requested only after the host-recorded evidence is available.
